# Vendored Diplomacy Engine

This directory contains `diplomacy` 1.1.2 from the upstream [`diplomacy/diplomacy`](https://github.com/diplomacy/diplomacy) repository at commit `df1d0892ce27501386d8dbf2e9948055ea960445`.

The source is vendored to keep adjudication reproducible and available when the inactive upstream package is unavailable from a package index.
The upstream `LICENSE`, acknowledgements, and source notices are retained unchanged.
